description: This file defines a setup wizard for channel configuration, including types, helper functions, and an adapter builder for integrating the wizard into a larger system.

methods.name: buildStatus
methods.description: Constructs the status object for a channel plugin based on the wizard's resolve and resolve functions.

methods.name: applySetupInput
methods.description: Applies user input to update the channel configuration, validating and resolving account IDs.

methods.name: trimResolvedValue
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string value, returning undefined if empty.

methods.name: collectCredentialValues
methods.description: Collects credential values from credential inspectors into a key-value object.

methods.name: applyWizardTextInputValue
methods.description: Applies a text input value to the configuration, using custom applySet if available.

methods.name: buildChannelSetupWizardAdapterFromSetupWizard
methods.description: Creates an adapter object for a channel plugin based on a setup wizard, including status and configuration functions.
